items.content_html: FlowCast is a lightweight Agile delivery forecasting tool that uses Monte Carlo simulation on historical throughput data. Instead of fixed deadlines, it provides probabilistic delivery ranges (50%, 85%, 95%) to support better decisions around scope, risk, and expectations. Built to make delivery uncertainty visible and actionable.

items.content_html: This program demonstrates how to create a basic web server using Node.js core HTTP module. The server handles client requests and responds with data in JSON format. It sets the appropriate content type and sends structured data such as id, name, and course. This approach is useful for building lightweight APIs without using external frameworks.
